categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Estone Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in advanced inorganic non-metallic composite materials and application solutions. Its main product categories include inorganic functional powder materials such as boehmite (used in lithium battery coating), silica powder, spherical alumina powder, and polymer materials including nano-composite flame retardants and ceramic silicone rubber flame retardants. These products serve key industries like new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, chip manufacturing, copper-clad laminates, and fire safety.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in producing high-purity boehmite powders with controlled particle size and low magnetic impurities, ceramic coating powders for lithium battery safety, and spherical alumina for thermal management and chip packaging. It has developed advanced manufacturing equipment such as fluidized bed jet mills and surface modification devices. The firm emphasizes R&D in nano-materials, ceramicized polymers, and solid oxide cell (SOC) systems, with a strong patent portfolio and in-house innovation centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international lithium battery manufacturers, wet-process diaphragm producers, leading new energy vehicle makers, electronics and semiconductor companies, and advanced communication firms. The company’s products are widely used in lithium battery safety coatings, electronic chip packaging, thermal management materials, and flame retardant applications in automotive and consumer electronics sectors. It also serves overseas factories of Chinese customers in Europe and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D centers in Anhui Province (Bengbu, Hefei, Chuzhou), and has subsidiaries in Chongqing and Shenzhen. It also has a joint venture in South Korea (LK ESTONE Co., Ltd.) and supplies customers in Japan, South Korea, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Its global market share in boehmite powder is the highest worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Estone operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain, producing key raw and functional materials such as inorganic powders and polymer composites that are critical inputs for lithium battery manufacturers, electronic component producers, and flame retardant material users. It supplies these materials to downstream battery makers, electronics manufacturers, and automotive OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in lithium battery safety materials, advanced electronic powders, and polymer flame retardants. It is actively developing solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and electrolysis cell (SOEC) systems for green energy applications. R&D efforts focus on nano-materials, high-purity quartz sand, ceramicized polymers, and thermal management materials. The firm maintains strong patent activity and collaborates with universities and research institutes to accelerate industrialization of new technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of advanced inorganic functional powders and polymer materials to industrial customers. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with sales contracts based on product delivery and acceptance. It also receives government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings in subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the leading global market share in boehmite powder for lithium battery coatings, with a strong competitive position supported by technology, product quality, and customer relationships. It faces competition from domestic and international suppliers in lithium battery materials, electronic powders, and flame retardants. Its strategic focus on innovation and scale aims to maintain and expand its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 504.5 million, an 8.6% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12 million, down 51% due to pricing pressure and raw material cost fluctuations. Total assets grew 8.4% to RMB 3.22 billion. The company invests about 9.57% of revenue in R&D. It has a registered capital of RMB 199.8 million and a workforce of 766 employees. The company is publicly listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Sci-Tech Innovation Board (ticker 688733).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Estone emphasizes high-purity, low-impurity inorganic powders with advanced particle size control, enabling enhanced lithium battery safety and performance. Its boehmite products improve battery thermal stability and puncture resistance, supporting higher energy density and safety standards. The company offers customized solutions, including nano-composite flame retardants and ceramicized polymers with superior fire resistance. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, along with patented technologies and automated production lines, provide differentiated quality, cost efficiency, and innovation leadership.
